HIGH_WHOLE_FILE_ENTROPY.description: Whole-file Shannon entropy is above the provisional development threshold.

HIGH_ENTROPY_BLOCK_RATIO.description: At least half of the analysed blocks exceed the provisional entropy threshold.

MIME_EXTENSION_INCONSISTENT.description: The detected MIME or ELF content is inconsistent with the file extension.

MALFORMED_ELF.description: The file begins with ELF magic but its ELF structure could not be parsed.

WRITABLE_EXECUTABLE_SECTION.description: At least one ELF section is both writable and executable.

WRITABLE_EXECUTABLE_SEGMENT.description: At least one ELF segment is both writable and executable.

ELF_ENTRY_POINT_ZERO.description: The ELF entry point is zero.

ELF_NO_SECTION_HEADERS.description: The ELF file has no section headers.

SUID_BIT_SET.description: The SUID permission bit is set.

SGID_BIT_SET.description: The SGID permission bit is set.

WORLD_WRITABLE.description: The file is writable by all users.

WORLD_WRITABLE_AND_EXECUTABLE.description: The file is both world-writable and world-executable.

TEMPORARY_DIRECTORY.description: The file is located under /tmp or /var/tmp.

DOWNLOAD_DIRECTORY.description: The file is located in a Downloads or İndirilenler directory.

REMOVABLE_OR_MOUNTED_MEDIA.description: The file is located on a mounted or removable-media path.

HIDDEN_PATH_COMPONENT.description: At least one component of the file path is hidden.
